N1.s: כל %lld הקאטלינגים החינמיים בשימוש. אפשר להמשיך באפליקציה ולשדרג, והקאטלינג הזה יישמר.
N1.back: all 5 the-cutlings the-free in-use. possible to-continue in-the-app and-to-upgrade, and-the-cutling the-this will-be-saved.
N1.why: Opens with S3's own words; 'אפשר' offers the way on without pushing, and 'באפליקציה' names the app so it never meets the item word, which is spelled the same.

N2.s: כל %lld הקאטלינגים החינמיים בשימוש. כדי לשמור עוד, אפשר לשדרג באפליקציה.
N2.back: all 5 the-cutlings the-free in-use. in-order to-save more, possible to-upgrade in-the-app.
N2.why: Same opening as N1 so Siri says the limit the same way everywhere; here the only way on is the app, so the line says where, not 'continue'.

N3.why: Masculine 'נשמר' agrees with קאטלינג; 'נשאר עוד אחד בחינם' is how an Israeli says one is left, with S1's 'בחינם'.

N4.why: The compact pair from S29, so the keyboard and the list title count the same way; 5 of 5 says they are full without a limit word.

N5.s: %lld מתוך %lld חינמיים. הקישו לשדרוג וזה יישמר
N5.back: 5 out-of 5 free(pl). tap(pl) for-upgrade and-this will-be-saved
N5.why: S29's count, then K1's 'הקישו לשדרוג', with 'וזה יישמר' promising the item being saved; numbers run in the same order, so plain %lld.

N6.why: A verbal noun on the button, as Hebrew iOS writes שמירה where this button usually stands; the batch's own word for unlocking.

N7.s: כל %lld הקאטלינגים החינמיים בשימוש. אחרי שדרוג, גם הקאטלינג הזה יישמר.
N7.back: all 5 the-cutlings the-free in-use. after upgrade, also the-cutling the-this will-be-saved.
N7.why: S3's opening again; 'גם' puts this one beside the five already kept, and 'אחרי שדרוג' follows S28.

N8.s: הקאטלינג הזה מחכה לכם. פתחו את האפליקציה ושדרגו, והוא יישמר.
N8.back: the-cutling the-this waits for-you(pl). open(pl) ACC the-app and-upgrade(pl), and-it will-be-saved.
N8.why: 'מחכה לכם' says it was kept without a second verb from the root of 'save'; plural imperatives like the vocabulary's 'הפעילו', and 'האפליקציה' keeps the name and the item word apart.
